actions: One explicitly selected Run or Review; never launches another action automatically.
sequence_per_window: Run -Kind newoff using the new isolated authoritative GPU main
Run -Kind observer using the new Native helper with --solver 1
Review using the immutable P2 r2 native reader
frozen_inputs: Reuse byte-bound logs/upl_gpu_observer_native_r1.inputs.json Smoke/Extended seeds. No XML edits, GenCase or shifted output time. Native512/fixed0, float-promoted n0=.25, dt=cadence=2^-24.
old_controls: Adopt sealed logs/upl_gpu_feedback_{Smoke|Extended}_r2.review.check.json and both owned solver receipts/raw outputs; do not rerun old main or old observer integration.
reader: Use actual immutable upl_gpu_feedback_Native_{Configuration}_r2 helper executable for --compare and --read-poro. Bind its program, compile/link receipts, tools, libraries and runtime without claiming old mutable source paths are current.
unchanged_gates: All original15 typed native arrays ID-aligned bit exact for newOFF vs retainedOFF and newobserver vs retainedobserver at every saved part
Actual time, native Step and typed signed dterror exact; signed dterror<=1e-14, not absolute margin
Read both old and new observer PARTs for three actual double J/n/theta arrays; finite/domain/derived n exact and every CSV byte equal old/new/retained
Final actual live GPU export byte equal last saved native CSV and retained live export
Every new Debug solve has memcheck0 errors and0 bytes leaked; no relaxations
new_paths: outputs/logs upl_gpu_k0_time_{Smoke|Extended}_r1_*; no old output or receipt overwritten
prerequisite_for_new_time_components: Both fresh native reviews must pass before the root admits Scale/FirstCurrent/FirstRequested component calls. This script never launches a time component.
